source: Owner's request 23.11.2026 (ChatGPT recommendation, reviewed by Claude): gold and the S&P 500 on Bybit Demo. Pre-registered: parameters fixed from the literature before any TradFi result was looked at.
title: Gold Regime – gold only

preregistration.hypothesis: TF1b: gold moves in long regimes; buying the end of pullbacks inside a bull regime of the ≈50-day trend (selling rallies in a bear regime) and skipping volatility shocks earns more per unit of risk than holding through them.
preregistration.why_these_parameters: Round conventional horizons on 24/7 4h candles: slow EMA ≈ 50 days (300), medium ≈ 10 days (60), slope over ≈ 5 days (30), pullback EMA ≈ 3.3 days (20); no entries while ATR% > 1.5× its 60-day median. Stop 3×ATR, dynamic chandelier trail 4× current ATR from the best price, no fixed target, exit when the 10-day trend crosses back. Not fitted.
preregistration.decision_rule: As TF1a; also compared with tf-trend-4h-30d on gold over the same days (does the regime/pullback logic add anything over plain TSMOM?).
